column1: Table 1
Chat
A cat? Hey, wake up. Can you hear me? You seem young… for a soul who's been through 9 lives.
The realm of the dead is lonely. Won’t you walk with me to the station?
Dead?
That’s right! The train will soon come to pick us up, we should get going!
But… Marie… She’s still waiting for me. I need to go back.
Marie? Is she your human?
*nods* She needs me. She’ll be so sad if she finds out I left her.
Is she the old lady who talks in circles?
You know her?
Come, this way!
What time is it now?
Oh! I need to go home right away. Papa might be back this time.
...is that so? What kind of person is your papa?
Marie? You’re here too?
She can’t hear you. Come, follow me!
What time is it now?
Oh! I need to go home right away. Papa might be back this time.
Sure. Your home is the one west of Heatherwoods, right?
This is… her memories?
You’re catching on. Come, look here!
What time is it now?
Oh! I need to go home right away. Papa might be back this time.
Two more spoons and I’ll take you there, okay?
What happened to her? Why is she like this?
Your poor lady has her soul in fragments, scattered all over this place. It will be hard for her to find the station
Can you help me find her?
Only if you agree to walk with me to the station. It’s rare to meet a friend here and I’ll be sad if you leave…
That’s not a problem. You help me find Marie, and then we’ll walk together to the station.
Let’s go then!
